segments.text: "Hey, I'm Sayaka Hiwatari. I work part-time at Iris Corporation as a debugger. I'm really glad you're gonna be my partner! Let's do our best! Yay!"

One day, Sayaka was suddently pulled into a strange dimension known as the Strain Area. There, she meets a woman from a mysterious group known as the Ludens, who claim to have awakened to self-awareness thanks to somebody's interference. ...At least, that's how it begins. Sayaka is the protagonist of this story. Before she woke up, it seems she mindlessly fought various opponents according to certain rules. Perhaps the God of Death happened to see her back then, somewhere?

Now she lives together with Shiina, who gave Sayaka her name. Since it wouldn't be prudent to stay unemployed forever, Shiina invited Sayaka to her own workplace—a game company. Looks like a happy work life is about to begin, huh? ♪ Her first job is to debug a new game called "End to Odyssey."

She's also a bit of an otaku. Maybe that's why she loves playtesting the games Shiina helps develop. As she continues debugging the company's in-house games, she starts encountering bizarre phenomena, the laws of reality begin to distort, and in time, she battles a threat that targets the entire world.
From official website

"Yes, I'm the director, Shiina Ninomiya. We're currently developing DLC for the second installment of World's Odyssey. It's called 'End to Odyssey!' It's only been released in Japan, so we're working hard to bring it worldwide."

She was the director of World's Odyssey, a VR-compatible MMORPG that remains wildly popular in this world. Currently, she's focused on directing its official sequel, End to Odyssey. She was once in a traffic accident with her mother. Her mother later passed away after developing a condition from the crash. As for Shiina, she also suffered life-threatening injuries, but narrowly survived—thanks to unexpectedly becoming a Luden. This is an extremely rare phenomenon, even on a global scale. She's incredibly lucky.

As a unique Luden and a beautiful director, she's gained a strong following among game fans. That said, she doesn't make many public appearances, so she's more of a "if you know you know" type of figure.

Leveraging the connections she built during End to Odyssey, she's still chasing new dreams. The development of her new title is her top priority. Her number one partner is Arata Mizunashi, who is currently missing. She treasures Sayaka, who became her roommate, just as much as she treasures Arata! Balancing her role as Sayaka's guardian and her duties as a director, she stands against the threats to this world!
From official website
"I'm Mai Touyama. Not... Higashiyama. I'm a programmer at Iris Corporation. Please... don't ask about my father. But feel free to ask about my little sister. Nice to meet you."

She's a woman who admired the world-famous programmer Arata, known among gamers globally, and joined Iris Corporation—his former workplace—because of that admiration. Before Arata disappeared, he trained her for a brief time, and Mai herself is a brilliant programmer who could rival him. She's now an essential member of the End to Odyssey development team.

She holds herself and others to strict standards, which often leads to conflict with other staff members! However, most of the team understands her, so those clashes rarely escalate into anything serious. ...Except when it comes to a staff member named Akaki, and Mai's own father.

Mai finds her mental strength from phone calls with her younger sister, Sanae. She lives alone in an apartment near the company building, and since she doesn't get to see Sanae often, she's always eager to talk to her. Still, even while enjoying her happy conversations with Sanae, she can't seem to forget about her missing best friend, Rottie... She's quite eccentric, but she slowly grows close with Sayaka, who joined the team as a part-timer. Surprising, isn't it? In truth, an unimaginable parasite stirs inside her body—something with the power to decide the fate of many. She's been trying to keep it suppressed, but... will she be able to keep it under control when the threat to the world draws near?
From official website
"My name is Yurisa Yamamura. I'm a medical intern, but I also help debug at Iris Corporation. My idol is Shiina Ninomiya! Please take good care of her instead of me!"

A medical intern working at Yamamura University Hospital in Sagami City. She passionately admires Shiina. Despite her busy schedule, she also works part-time at Iris Corporation. It's not because she's in financial trouble—it's to see Shiina more often, of course.

She's been involved as a debugger since the development of World's Odyssey, and there's even a rumor that the popular character "Lily Hopes", originally designed with blonde hair, was changed to look more like Yurisa. It seems Shiina recognizes her as one of her important partners.

As for Yurisa herself, she holds some strong feelings for Shiina that go beyond just being coworkers. Shiina, aware of this, skillfully postpones giving her a real answer. Though handing over a spare key to her apartment may have been a mistake—just saying, haha!
Sayaka's direct supervisor is Yurisa. She seems to be good at looking after her team. While she views Sayaka as a rival, she still stands with everyone to face the world's looming threats!
From official website

"I'm Iris, the chairwoman of Iris Corporation. Just sitting around doing nothing is tiring... so I decided to work hard here. Please look forward to End to Odyssey, which I'm developing with Shiina and the others."

The chairwoman and founder of Iris Corporation, a company that develops and publishes games. She is a Luden. Together with the current CEO, Werner Glock, she gathered the former staff of Enigma Corporation to form Iris Corporation. It seems she's created other things, too, but it's unclear how much she actually remembers about them...

Her ideal life is to simply make games filled with dreams and hope. End to Odyssey, the sequel to World's Odyssey, is shaping up to have quite the dark and intense story under Shiina's direction, which pains Iris. Poor thing...
For some reason, she treats the newly hired Sayaka rather coldly. There's a very serious reason for that, but it's too much for Sayaka, so we won't explain it here...
From official website

"Huh? Me? I'm Akaki. A-ka-ki, alright? Not Akagi. I used to be the best programmer at Iris Corporation... But ever since Mai showed up... ugh, forget it! Just leave me alone already! I'm not staying at this company much longer anyway!"
A programmer at Iris Corporation who often tries to act like a lead. She constantly clashes with Mai. It's probably because Mai has made her look inferior.

Her snideness makes her a handful, but the company's too busy to consider firing her. Whether that's good for her or not is up for debate... Later in the story, she experiences an unexpected turning point. She also runs a fashion website called Venus, which seems to play a role in that.
From official website

"I'm Sumika Tokiwa! Chief programmer at Iris Corporation. Mai is better than me as a programmer. But as chief, I'm doing my best to keep the team running smoothly! Until Arata comes back to Iris Corp, I'll keep pushing forward!"
A lead at Iris Corporation who oversees all the programmers.

Though her programming skills don't match up to Mai's, her management skills greatly contribute to the company. Her attention to detail and ability to juggle schedules is top-class. When Shiina isn't feeling well, Sumika even steps in as acting director. Sayaka ends up relying on her soon after joining Iris Corp.
From official website

"What's up? I'm Kouji Touyama. I'm a somewhat well-known character... I... I said somewhat, okay? It's not weird if you've never heard of me. My daughter, Mai? Ah, that girl... she's scary. We live separately now. Hey! I haven't done anything wrong, alright?!"
The father of Mai and Sanae. He pushed his way into marriage with his wife, a painter, by saying they shared art in common.

Unlike his wife, who specializes in abstract art, he focuses exclusively on 2D anime-style girls. After the company he worked for went bankrupt, he lost motivation and became a hopeless slob, ending up estranged from his entire family.

That said, he did help get Mai a job at Iris Corporation, so it seems he's not completely cut off. Still, Mai wants nothing to do with him and seems to actively avoid him. There are even rumors that she once tried to kill him...?
He's as rough as he looks, but he's nice to people who flatter him. Thankfully, both Iris Corporation and Sayaka figured out how to deal with him easily enough...
From official website

cast.characterName: ヴェルナー・グロック
cast.originalCharacterName: ヴェルナー・グロック

segments.text: "I'm Werner Glock, president of Iris Corporation. It's important to live up to such a title, isn't it? My old company was Enigma. I wonder how they're holding up these days..."
The easygoing president of Iris Corporation. Like many others, he transferred from Enigma Corporation. He supposedly left due to a difficult coworker he just couldn't get along with.
He's very close with Chairwoman Iris and seems to know many secrets about this world, but he believes it's best not to talk about them, so he keeps his mouth shut.
Despite being laidback, he's actually a cautious and unpredictable man. Not exactly my type, honestly. Though he's pretty nice to Sayaka.
From official website
"Ahahahaha! ARATA MIZUNASHI here! The world's greatest programmer! I'll hack despair and death themselves... Just kidding! Heeheehee!!!"
A mysterious figure who goes by the name ARATA MIZUNASHI. It'd be improper to say too much about him just yet.
He created the Glitch Girls, and he schemes to destroy the world.
His true identity and goals remain unclear, but beneath his carefree facade, he hides a deep, burning rage. A dangerous man who doesn't pull his punches—approach with extreme caution!
From official website
"I... I am... Lilith Yamamura... Why do I have this name? It's so irritating... Yeah, I'm connected to Yamamura Hospital... As for Shiina, I'll definitely kill her someday... That's all."
One of the hastily created Ludens made by ARATA. Constructed using data from the character Lily Hopes, a certain someone's memories, and the earthbound spirits of Yamamura University Hospital.

The earthbound spirits are more of a concept—technically, even ghosts are called Ludens in this world. So she's essentially a spirit who was given flesh and made to resemble Lily. Due to lingering memories, she knows about Yurisa. She also knows about Shiina through Yurisa, so she doesn't seem too confused. However, her brain has been tampered with to increase feelings of love and violence, making her emotionally unstable. She's frequently angry at others and even at herself.
She is under ARATA's control and seems like a rather dangerous opponent.
From official website
"Hey there... I'm Naraku Morikubo. I used to be... well, Hinata's idol. What I am now... not even I care to know."

Another of ARATA's hastily created Ludens. She was created based off a recent deceased idol and her memories of her past. Though the body was supposedly in pieces... perhaps Eni helped reconstruct it.

Naraku is cold, blunt, and sharp-tongued. She harbors overwhelming sadness deep inside. The brightness from her idol days is completely gone. You'd think after coming back to life, she could be a bit more cheerful.
Fascinated by analyzing the logic behind tragic deaths, she supports ARATA's rampage. Her motives make her a terrifying foe for Sayaka.
From official website
"Indeed, I am Huuki Hiizumi. By some strange twist of fate, I am now joined in this form. I look forward to meeting you all."

Another Luden created by ARATA. Formed using data from Clea Glaive, a certain someone's memories, and the thoughts of Kaede Hiizumi's mother. She's essentially a living spirit. Fittingly, the data from Claire seemed to resonate with her more than with Kaede.

She resembles her source: powerful, righteous, and brave. Though her personality clashes with ARATA's, she honors the fact that he created her and fights for him. Not the smartest decision, in my opinion. If Sayaka can appeal to her sense of honor, the tides may turn.
From official website
"Ahahaha! It's the adorable, adorable Kikii! You foolish humans. Surrender to my magic! Especially that old hag Lucil--Here we go! One-two! Boom-cha-cha! Ahaaa!"
One of ARATA's Luden creations. Made using data from Lucil Filarete, a certain someone's memories, and a spirit that had long resided in Svetlana Amou's shop.
Think of her like a Japanese "zashiki-warashi"—a house spirit. She hates Svetlana, but not in a particularly harmful way. She's more of a loud nuisance.

However, after ARATA MIZUNASHI made her his assassin, she was twisted by destructive urges. She now finds joy in hurting people and is an incredibly dangerous entity. Sayaka will face her many times. Hopefully, Svetlana can eventually take her back...
From official website

"I'm Arata... Arata Mizunashi. Looks like there's a big mess... again. Is this the first time? Or the third? I can't really tell. I'll be counting on your power to cross the worlds. Don't worry--I'll be doing my part, too! ...Wait, is she going to read this comment? That's not good! No details for now. Catch you later!"
A brilliant programmer who was the lead at Iris Corporation. Shiina's best friend and precious partner.

However, he has mysteriously vanished, and only a few at Iris Corp. know the truth. Technically, it's not a disappearance, but a "leave of absence." His friends continue to believe in his return. After all, he plays a critical role in keeping the world looping. A loop designed to end the loop... how ironic.
Even without him, Director Shiina and his protégé Mai are doing well as programmers, so development hasn't suffered too much. Though that's kind of sad in its own way, haha!
Sayaka will likely encounter him near the story's climax.
From official website

"I'm Chloe Aaron... I played Celica Clayton in the World's Odyssey live-action film. People call me an idol actress, but... I think it's so dumb. Haaah... I just want to say goodbye to this world. Together with Lena... you know?"
Born to two globally famous actors, she followed in their footsteps and became a successful actress herself. Recently, she's been active in Japan.
Her big breakthrough came from her acclaimed performance as Celica in the live-action adaptation of World's Odyssey. Since Celica was the film's protagonist, she earned lots of support from gamers.

Truthfully? She doesn't seem to like games very much. On top of that, a certain incident during her stay in Japan left a devastating mark on her mental state, hence the terrifying expression she always wears. Driven by her purpose that arose from that event, she pushes herself day and night. It isn't exactly despair that drives her. Whether that's a good thing or not... who knows. She's one of the hardest people for Sayaka to connect with.
She visits Iris Corp. to assist with development while carrying a dangerous burden. What will everyone do once they realize her true intentions?
From official website
"Ah, um, I'm Chloe Faleena... It's a weird name, right? Faleena... If you look up the meaning... it bums me out! That aside, please take care of Chloe Aaron--er, I mean Celica!"
One of the Ludens hastily created by ARATA. She was formed using data of the character Celica Clayton, a certain someone's memories, and the body of Raffy Candy—Chloe's manager who died of illness.

Because of the data, she looks a lot like Celica, but since she loved Celica Clayton to begin with, she's totally happy about it. Even after returning from death, she wishes to continue serving as Chloe's manager, and ARATA assigns her a special mission.

She was originally a passionate Celica fan and a gamer. She played World's Odyssey long before it became popular. Her obsession manifests in bizarre, almost superhuman skills. Although she didn't serve as Chloe's manager for long in life, their trust ran deep. Who would've thought she'd continue being a manager after death?! Later in the story, Sayaka will come face-to-face with Faleena's despair.
From official website

cast.characterName: スヴェトラーナ・天羽
cast.originalCharacterName: スヴェトラーナ・天羽

segments.text: "I'm Svetlana Amou. The one... 'inside' Lucil... I'm a clothing designer now. I even have my own shop! It's a pleasure to meet you all."

An internationally renowned fashion designer and boutique owner. She contributed costume designs to characters in World's Odyssey. Seems like she found more satisfaction in making real clothes than virtual ones, so she returned to her home country after the game took off. She's currently not in Sagami City.

Reality and games aren't so different, you say? Clever, but despite this world's distortion, it still isn't equal to a game. Svetlana likely thinks the same. Her extensive knowledge of the world might be linked to her involvement with Lucil Filarete's design. She's a figure worthy of being called a witch or a sage.

I wonder why Sayaka travels abroad to meet her. Maybe there will be some chaos, even in the development of End to Odyssey. But hey... without drama, it wouldn't be fun, right? In a distant land, she and Sayaka will face off. Why? That's for us to find out.
From official website
"I'm Basilissa, a sound artist. I'm actually a world-famous Luden, but I'm laying low now! Honest! You believe me, right, God of Death? People can change... hehehe♪"

A pretty famous sound creator with over a decade of global activity. Her age is unknown. She's open about being a Luden and even works as a model, using her beauty. The tracks she provided for World's Odyssey were highly acclaimed—so much so that people played the game just to hear her music. From intense rock to emotional ballads, her musical range is vast.

She also handles voice recording and is a key contributor to the World's Odyssey team. However, she's not affiliated with either Enigma or Iris Corp., and always demands outrageous payment. I suppose that's the only negative thing about her.

She has some personal history with Shiina and sometimes initiates contact with her. Unusual, considering her typical aloofness. There's also a certain person she adores in a very specific, fetishistic way... That affection ends up triggering a major incident later on. Needless to say, she's no saint. Be careful around her, okay?
From official website
"I'm Hinata Morikubo! When it comes to World's Odyssey, leave it to me! My site is full of walkthroughs! My hobby, or, uh... job... is hacking. Ah, oops! I wasn't supposed to say that, huh?!"

A somewhat well-known hacker in Japan's underground circles. Her parents work in international trade and are often away, so she spent time online to ease the loneliness. That's where she honed her hacking skills.

On the surface, she only runs idol fan pages and a World's Odyssey database site. She even did official PR work for Enigma Corp., so she's essentially a staff member. These days, her obsession seemed to be centered on the actress Chloe Aaron.
How exactly she ends up involved with Sayaka remains to be seen... But they'll unexpectedly cross paths. One day, she hacks into... Iris Corp.! Will Sayaka be able to fend her off?
From official website
"I'm Sanae Touyama! My big sis is suuuuper overprotective! But I'm independent nooow! Still, I'm super proud of her!"
An employee at Aggle, the parent company of Enigma. She's Mai's emotional pillar and gives her great advice.

Unlike her sister Mai, she isn't a programmer—instead, she works in reception and accounting. She nearly died from an illness once, and her family has doted on her ever since. In order to gain independence from her overly attached sister, she started living alone... Those Touyama family dynamics are rather complex, aren't they?
Her mom, Phyllis, is a traveling painter, while her dad and sister both work for the same company. Though the family rarely gathers together, they seem to get along reasonably well.
From official website

cast.characterName: ロッテン・ドールハート
cast.originalCharacterName: ロッテン・ドールハート

segments.text: "Hi, hiii! I'm Rotten Dollheart! But call me Rottie, okay?♪ Right now, I'm in a super mysterious place! I wanna show it to Mai and Liliana too! But don't worry. I'm doing fine! Say hi to my mom for me!"
A cheerful, caring girl who befriended young Mai when Mai traveled to Romania with her painter mother. They became best friends, with Liliana joining to form a tight-knit trio.

Later, Rottie visited Japan with her family—but she went missing soon after. Her case was treated as a possible crime, but after seven years with no leads, her trail went cold. Sayaka will end up investigating her disappearance. After reuniting with Mai and Sayaka, Rottie begins a new life—
But how will she handle the chaos that follows?
From official website
"Ah, um... I'm Levin. Right now... I'm the temporary manager of the Night Owl café. Haaah... how did it come to this? Well... I don't necessary hate it..."

Currently employed as the temporary manager of the Night Owl café by its owner, Hajime. A strange Luden who dislikes scary stories, but ironically knows a lot about them. He's strikingly handsome, which supposedly draws many regular female customers.
He sometimes lashes out angrily to hide his fears. Apparently, his fans enjoy that, too? I don't quite get it...

While tired of the madness consuming the world, he fulfills his role as manager and keeps a certain secret entrusted to him by Alice. He sells a variety of goods to adventurers as well. Sayaka can stock up on supplies with him.
From official website

"Good day to you! I'm Alice, Iris's... uh, I guess, nominal assistant. Lately, I've gotten hooked on stocks... And I've become a billionaire! But there are things in this world money can't buy. Don't you agree, God of Death?"

The true creator of Alice Code, the game engine beloved by developers worldwide. While she officially works as an auditor at Aggle Corp., she's also developed various other general-purpose engines. The staff at Aggle don't seem too fond of her.

When she learned that Arata and Shiina had transferred to Iris Corp.—and that many others wanted to leave Enigma too—she helped them leave and find their feet. Because of that, she's not just disliked, but downright resented by those at Enigma. Her part in creating the Alice Code doesn't matter to them. As for Alice herself, she brushes it off, saying she only did what was best for Iris Corp., and by extension, Aggle Corp. Nowadays, she mostly lives off day trading. Not that she needed to; she was already wealthy enough to live comfortably for the rest of her life.

She might seem like someone with a strong sense of duty, but really, she just does whatever sounds interesting. Her greatest obsession is observing death in living beings (because of the variety, she says). It's an absolutely deranged fetish.

She seems like someone who might host a death game, huh... In reality, she's found a different, bizarre way to satisfy that urge, one too outlandish to explain here. Sayaka will end up relying on her many times... Good luck with that!
From official website
"Yo! I'm Nova the great! Ludens aren't so rare anymore, so I'm out here being a detective. Wanna be my client? If it's about Sagami City, leave it to me! ♪"

A Luden who works as a detective in Japan. Despite her intimidating appearance and flashy lines, she's reliable and loyal to her clients, so she's earned a good reputation. She was originally asked to collect gossip for Alice, but distanced herself once she realized there wasn't much in it for her. When it comes to knowledge about Sagami City, no one surpasses her.
Sayaka will be saved more than once thanks to Nova's deep insight and wealth of knowledge.
From official website

"Liliana Pinnata. Nice to meet you--or maybe it's just been a while? I'm a follower of Aphesis. I perform exorcisms. You demons who twist people's fates... I will never forgive you. That includes you, Mai..."
A candidate for leadership within Aphesis. A devout and capable believer who fully understands the teachings of the cult.
She relentlessly pursues Mai for a certain reason. The reason would shock most people, but Mai seems to know exactly why...

She learned the truth of the world from the cult's founder, and through her mastery of the Code, she can perform feats akin to miracles. She seems unrelated to game development. I wonder how her path will cross with Sayaka's.
Following Mai, she travels to Sagami City, where our story takes place. With the entire world on the brink, will she be able to hold onto her beliefs?
From official website
"Hi there! I'm Liddy! I'm the director at Enigma Corp. I oversee World's Odyssey! I just wish Shiina Ninomiya the best of luck!"

A director at Enigma Corp. She served as the assistant director of World's Odyssey, and now takes the role of director for its sequel, End to Odyssey. Even after Shiina and the core team left Enigma, she chose not to follow them to Iris Corp. and stayed behind.

It's not that she has a bad relationship with Shiina and the others, but she has different ideas. It'll be Sayaka's first time meeting her, but as for the God of Death... who knows? Wasn't she in a hospital room somewhere...?
From official website
"Kaede Hiizumi here. I'm the mastermind behind the site Ogre.com. Oh, but that's a secret, okay? The wise hawk--and merchant--hides her talons!"

She founded the global shopping website Ogre.com. A young business prodigy, she primarily works overseas to keep operations running smoothly. Her real name is a secret, and few know her true identity.

However, the character Clea Glaive from World's Odyssey shares an eerily similar background. It surprised Kaede herself when she played the game. Although she wasn't involved in the development of the game, don't you find it strange that a character just like her appears in it?
How did Shiina, the game's writer, get her personal information? Well, maybe the God of Death already has a guess.

At first, she's skeptical of the Iris Corp. crew, but after a major incident at a department store, she becomes a reliable ally. Sayaka will have to fight with everything she's got during the incident...
From official website
"I'm Chiri Sendo. A detective in Sagami City... I patrol the streets alongside my superior, Senji Hiizumi. I hope we can get along."
A female detective working directly under Senji Hiizumi at the Sagami Police Station. She's serious and capable.
She seems to have some kind of secret... but then again, doesn't everyone? She gets caught up in a major incident alongside Sayaka. Hopefully, she makes it out safely.
From official website
"I'm Sugiura, an associate professor at Sagami University. I'm still learning a lot from Director Yamamura. I hope we get the chance to meet at the hospital someday."
An associate professor working at Yamamura University Hospital. He's quite handsome and popular with the students. He doesn't let it go to his head, however.
He's diligent and passionate about his work. Being a good guy sometimes feels like a death flag, doesn't it? I hope he's okay.
From official website

"Um, hello? I'm Maruko Mita, the store clerk. I work at Svetlana's shop! She's seriously like a real magician... Every day is exciting!♪ Oh, and lately, those strange voices we used to hear at the store... have stopped. Hmm, maybe I should ask the manager about it!"

A clerk who works under Svetlana and affectionately calls her "manager." She's all bravado when promoting the store, but in reality, she's timid and yelps at every little noise. Her skittishness seems to stem from past trauma. I wonder what happened... Maybe Sayaka will meet her someday.
From official website
"My name...? For now, you can call me Snark. I admire the strong. Those who never lose sight of their goal and continue to grow... May those strong people find fortune."
A mysterious Luden who appears in Sagami City's subway system. He introduces himself as Snark. He looks like a station attendant, but his true identity is unknown. Well, I know it, but still.

Despite his immense power, he avoids getting directly involved in anything. Not out of fear or unwillingness—he's simply too powerful and doesn't want to alter the outcome unpredictably. His logic makes sense, honestly. Maybe he's some kind of tsundere?
Still, Sayaka ends up borrowing a good deal of his power, but only partially... Is he a boojum? Or something else entirely...?
From official website
"Hey, doing okay? I'm Shizu. I'm in the running for leadership in Aphesis. I'm just like Liliana. Those who believe will be saved!"
A member of the Aphesis Cult and a colleague of Liliana. She is high-ranking and leads other cult members.
She constantly wears a friendly smile. She's well-versed in the cult's doctrines and extremely knowledgeable about the intricate workings of the world.
Liliana relies on her deeply. If you were to make her your enemy... she'd be quite a formidable opponent.
From official website
"I'm Hajime Ando. I run a café called Night Owl. However... I've left the place in the hands of a capable young man. I'll be traveling for a while, so let's meet again sometime!"
A man whose love for the occult led him to collect strange artifacts and ghost stories. He's well-known in the community and even opened a café that doubles as a mini-museum named Night Owl.

This time around, he found a trustworthy Luden named Levin and left the shop in his care. He's off on a long journey overseas. He supposedly won't come home for a while. Wonder how much we'll see of him?
From official website
"I am Enishi Yamamura. Director of the affiliated hospital at Sagami University. My daughter Yurisa is quite a handful. Who would've thought she'd take a part-time job at a game company!"

Director of Yamamura University Hospital and Yurisa's father. The hospital is doing well, but his relationship with his daughter is rocky. I heard he's known to engage in shady business practices that technically don't break the law.
We'll see what kind of ending awaits for someone like him... Let's hope he improves as a person.
From official website
"Welcome! I'm nothing special. No need to say my name. Our store offers unique products you won't find anywhere else... Especially for a lovely lady like yourself. I'll be sure to make you smile!"
An ordinary convenience store clerk... on the surface.
He talks casually with customers, even if he doesn't know them. God of Death, do you know anybody like this? Even he barely stays out of trouble in this world. I wouldn't recommend his company.
Still, he may offer some insight into what's considered "normal."
From official website
"I'm Senji Hiizumi, a detective in Sagami City. With how dangerous the world is lately, I can't afford to skip any patrols. My wife and daughter--who works overseas--are my pride and joy... heh."
A well-known, tough-looking detective in Sagami City. He's driven by justice but has a dangerous belief that anything goes when it comes to punishing criminals, which has pushed him to violence.
Still, he's incredibly sweet to his daughter and a devoted husband. Doesn't he have it way better than he deserves? Ha.
I just hope Sayaka never gets involved with the police.
From official website

"I'm Agent Natsuo Munakata. Summer Life Corporation...? Ah, what a nostalgic name. But it has almost nothing to do with me. Who'd have thought a little hobby would go this far... but it's over now..."
Not the same person as the real Natsuo Munakata.
His appearance is uncannily similar, but we'll just keep the reason a mystery. He seems to be investigating this world for a certain purpose.
From official website
"Huh? Me? I'm Rin Asukaze! I'm an agent too, okay? I'm like, SUPER busy! Anyone who gets in the way of my honeymoon with ARATA... will regret it!"
A different person from the real Rin Asukaze, though they look alike.
It's strange how similar they are... But don't let her sweet appearance fool you—her personality is the complete opposite. She's a dangerously volatile woman.
From official website
